title: “I use ChatGPT to humanize my words”: Affordances and Risks of ChatGPT to Autistic Users
reasoning: The paper identifies and analyzes the 'autistic sense of justice' as a core thematic finding (Section 3.2.3). It evaluates how users' moral distress and ethical principles—specifically regarding environmental impact and data exploitation—conflict with the functional utility of LLMs, influencing their decision to use or reject the technology.
